features.title: Your money stays yours
features.body: Your funds sit in your own Deriv account. We are not a broker and never hold or move your money.

features.title: Live prices, no signup
features.body: Real prices straight from Deriv, updating every second, before you commit to anything.

features.title: Start in minutes
features.body: Opening a Deriv account takes a couple of minutes, and you can practise free before risking anything.

defaultCampaign.name: Default
defaultCampaign.headline: Trade volatility indices, any hour
defaultCampaign.subhead: Powered by Deriv. Live prices around the clock, and your money stays in your own Deriv account — we never touch it.

tradeTypes.name: Rise / Fall
tradeTypes.body: Say whether the price will finish higher or lower. The simplest place to start.

tradeTypes.name: Even / Odd
tradeTypes.body: Call whether the last digit of the price lands odd or even.

tradeTypes.name: Over / Under
tradeTypes.body: Pick a number and say whether the last digit finishes above or below it.

tradeTypes.name: Matches / Differs
tradeTypes.body: Choose a digit from 0 to 9 and say whether the last digit will match it.

tradeTypes.name: Accumulators
tradeTypes.body: Your stake grows on every tick the price stays inside a range, and you can close any time. If the price leaves the range, the stake is lost.
